question: In which season do Western disturbances lead to rainfall in Northern states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Winter season**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Western disturbances are weather phenomena that originate over the Mediterranean Sea and move eastward.
 
• These disturbances bring sudden winter rain to the northwestern parts of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The moisture carried by these disturbances results in precipitation, including rainfall and sometimes snow in the northern states.
 
• Western disturbances are more frequent and intense during the winter season, contributing significantly to the winter rainfall.
 
• This precipitation is crucial for the Rabi crops, which are sown in winter and harvested in spring.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Summer Season**

 
 
• The period from March to June in India, characterized by hot temperatures.
 
• Western disturbances are less common during this season.
 
 
 
• **Monsoon Season**
 
 
• The rainy season in India, spanning from June to September.
 
• Rainfall during this period is primarily due to the southwest monsoon winds, not western disturbances.
 
 
 
• **Spring Season**
 
 
• The transitional season between winter and summer, occurring from February to March.
 
• Western disturbances might still cause some rainfall, but it is less common compared to winter.
